references.label: TMC 14.35.250 block 120
references.quote: 1 Size of the cold branch pipe, or both the hot and cold branch pipes.

references.label: TMC 14.35.250 block 121
references.quote: 2 Appliances, Appurtenances or Fixtures not included in this Table may be sized by reference to the fixtures having a similar flow rate and frequency of use.

references.label: TMC 14.35.250 block 122
references.quote: 3 The listed fixture unit values represent their load on their cold water supply. The separate cold water and hot water fixture unit valve for fixtures having both hot and cold water connections may each be taken as three-quarter (3/4) of the listed total value of the fixture.

references.label: TMC 14.35.250 block 123
references.quote: 4 The listed minimum supply branch pipe sizes for individual fixtures are the nominal (I.D.) pipe size.

references.label: TMC 14.35.250 block 124
references.quote: 5 For fixtures or supply connections likely to impose continuous flow demands, determine the required flow in gallons per minute (GPM), and add it separately to the demand (in GPM) for the distribution system or portions thereof.

references.label: TMC 14.35.250 block 126
references.quote: 7 When sizing flushometer systems, see Section 610.10.

references.label: TMC 14.35.250 block 127
references.quote: 8 Reduced fixture unit loading for additional hose bibbs is to be used only when sizing total building demand and for pipe sizing when more than one hose bibb is supplied by a segment of water-distributing pipe. The fixture branch to each hose bibb shall be sized on the basis of 2.5 fixture units.

references.label: TMC 14.35.250 block 128
references.quote: 9 The water supply for lawn sprinkler/irrigation system shall be sized by the total gallons per minute (GPM) required on the largest zone using Appendix A. The size of the water service for structures adding a lawn irrigation/sprinkler system shall be calculated by adding the total gallons per minute flow required for the largest zone on the lawn irrigation/sprinkler system to the total gallons per minute flow for the structure. Size of the service shall be determined by utilizing all applicable requirements found in Appendix A and/or Chapter 6.
